verdict.rationale: The only agent-oriented documentation in the pack is MCP.md, a plain-markdown file in the repo (also served raw) that describes the agent tool surface: email, label and AI-assist tools, plus how to connect with a session token. An agent could be pointed at it, but it is integration docs for the MCP server, not docs packaged for LLM consumption. Missing for 10: an llms.txt or llms-full.txt file, a curated agent-readable docs index or site, coverage beyond the MCP tool list, and any independent corroboration that agents consume these docs.
